senses.gloss: Udyoga = Udyogaparvan. § 4 (Anukram.): I, 1, 89 (Virāṭoº-sāravān…Bhāratadrumaḥ).--§ 10 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 333 (= Sainyodyogaparvan?).--§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 98, 4484 (allusion to Ambopākhyānap.).--§ 795c (Mahābhārata): XVIII, 6, 278. Cf. VI, 1614.

Udyogaparvan (“the book relating the preparations for war”), the fifth book of the Mhbhr. § 10 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 329 (= Sainyodyogaparvan?).--§ 11 (do.): I, 2, 492, 517 (said to comprise 6698 ślokas). Cf. Udyoga.
